name: Blyth's Rosefinch
extract: Blyth's rosefinch (Carpodacus grandis) or the Himalayan rosefinch is a species of finch in the family Fringillidae.  It is found in northern Afghanistan to the western Himalayas.  Its natural habitats are temperate forest and boreal shrubland.  It is sometimes considered a subspecies of the red-mantled rosefinch.
